## Genuine current-source reproduction

Baseline590a85501d05f0aafe5571915f18cc07bd4d9dd4. Actual packed purchases complete Storage2,2, DeliveryBay20,2, q1 Shower20,14 and q1 Shower5,14, Cell5,24, through real construction/material deliveries. Both Shower instances have hygiene capacity2, physically owned heads and working doors. Their canonical anchors are21,15 and6,15, in existing instanceId order.

A later ordinary full-square wall at21,15 completes, blocking only the first Shower anchor. The second6,15 still has a genuine prisoner-context path through door5,16, including from the actually admitted prisoner's current tile. Public Guard hire and AdmitPrisoner, then hygiene-only EditRegimeBlock for every actual schedule block. No injected stock, actor/needs, world, route verdict or render feed.

After9000actual ticks, both live and encodedV8 Load: ZERO shower-performing ticks, hygiene50920→14920, while2+2 hygiene places remain and the second Shower is reachable. Adjacent legal wall22,15, same live/V8 flow:1428shower-performing ticks, hygiene50600. Actual fixture physical ownership/room identity persists.

Typed production baseline2RED/2legal in tests/integration/later-usable-shower-selection.test.ts. Independent coordinates use literal clockwise5x5 Shower input; exact owners and authored positions checked. Initial nonexistent fixture-property type error was removed before strict typechecking; retained as preparation error, not a source defect.

## Cause and existing-rule scope

RoomInstanceRegistry.findAvailableForUse correctly orders rooms by instanceId and checks capacity/use occupancy, but ActionSystem.resolveTargetInstance rejects the first selected blocked anchor only AFTER selection. Therefore it abandons the entire room action instead of trying the next eligible instance. Existing#2008 correctly added this anchor eligibility and existing candidate-action fallback for a single invalid room; this new two-room case is its distinct selection gap. The failed first room must not hide a second legal instance of the same preferred action.

Parent reviewed both real sources and approved an optional ephemeral eligibility predicate inside existing findAvailableForUse (defaulttrue for unchanged clients), passed only from regular room action selection using existing current navigation graph tileToRegion membership. Preserve sorted priority, capacity/Infinity/occupancy and no-eligible existing fallback. No new interior/per-seat target, global path policy, accommodation/claims/persistence, tariff or player wording.

Fresh successful Shower+anchor and second+room+blocked searches, full#2008 and#532 bodies read: no exact duplicate. #532 is deliberate category/ranking balance/content, not this actual same-action instance eligibility defect. Production correction and producer omission proof follow on an isolated branch; browser-free diagnosis.
title: Blocked first Shower hides a later navigable Shower from action selection
